name: read_spss
title: Read an SPSS file by extension

origin.description: Reads an SPSS file, using the extension to choose sav or por.
origin.usage: read_spss(file, user_na = FALSE, col_select = NULL, skip = 0, n_max = Inf, .name_repair = "unique")

arguments.name: user_na
arguments.text: When true, user-defined missings are kept.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

origin.details: Any other extension is an error. The remaining arguments are passed to read_sav or read_por.

translation.description: Reads an SPSS file, using the extension to choose sav or por.
translation.usage: read_spss(file, user_na=False, col_select=None, skip=0, n_max=float("inf"), name_repair="unique")

arguments.name: user_na
arguments.text: When true, user-defined missings are kept.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

translation.details: Any other extension is an error. The remaining arguments are passed to read_sav or read_por.
translation.example:
from haven import read_spss
d = read_spss("/home/ahmed/R/library/haven/examples/iris.sav")
print(d.nrow, d.names[0])
